headline: Anthropic's debut did not stop the declines. WIG20 lost almost 2 percent
summary: Anthropic shares rose 17.1 percent in their debut session on Nasdaq. Major US indexes still closed notably lower, and weaker sentiment also spread to markets in Asia, Europe and Poland.
why: Anthropic is a San Francisco artificial intelligence company, and a listing is a major test of investor appetite for AI firms. Broad market moves influence index and sector valuations.
why_moved: Anthropic's debut rally took place while major US indexes closed lower, and weaker sentiment spread to Asian, European and Polish markets.
original_headline: Debiut Anthropic nie zatrzymał spadków. WIG20 tracił prawie 2 proc.
